run_scenario_object: run a BenchmarkScenarioImportedFromJson scenario in oracle mode and return failures from the event log
run_scenario_from_hf_tuple: run a scenario from a HuggingFace tuple by extracting the scenario and delegating to _run_scenario_object
run_import_export_from_hf_tuple: test a complete import/export cycle by exporting a scenario to JSON, re-importing it, and running in oracle mode
test_scenarios_from_iterator: test scenarios from an iterator using parallel processing with stream_pool and a 5 minute timeout per scenario
test_gaia2_mini_scenarios_hf: test GAIA2 mini scenarios from the HuggingFace dataset for test and validation splits in GitHub Actions
